room.camera: top-down 3/4 RPG fixed, no vanishing-point perspective
room.renderMethod: nearest-neighbor only; integer scale preferred; no CSS blur/bilinear smoothing
room.movement: static room diorama, no free drag/rotate, interactive hotspots only

shading.dropShadow: painted at 1x, 1–2 opaque pixels; light from top-left

artworkChecklist: All 11 decor sprites and background are ORIGINAL PNG with alpha, not screenshots or hotlinked web art
All silhouettes legible at natural 1x resolution on 320x224 base room
No soft antialias, blur, gradients baked into sprites or inconsistent outlines
Light highlights above-left, shadow bottom-right on every asset
Visual style and color matching audited next to live Pokémon Chuyển Sinh native sprites
Object layer does not cover machine controls, PC Back button or trophy hotspot
360px mobile and desktop 2x captures reviewed side-by-side
Rare trophy stat-neutral, not on shop purchase paths
No artwork asset listed here is considered implemented until a PNG exists and is previewed in-game
